<a id="angry_shark"></a>
## Shark Score: `angry_shark.yml`

A menacing orchestral film score in the manner of Jaws (John Williams), a low figure speeding up as
the shark comes. A creeping cell of three low notes in the basses, first in slow notes with
silences, then in eighths as each scene is faster; a tuba, horn calls and timpani; a chase on i VI
iv V; a calm stretch of harp and strings before it comes back.

<a id="four_wheels_g"></a>
## Eighties Synth Film Theme: `four_wheels_g.yml`

A mid-eighties synth film theme in the manner of Axel F (Harold Faltermeyer), with a hook of its
own. The hook starts alone on a saw lead, short notes with gaps, then the drum machine, a sixteenth-
note synth bass and synth brass stabs come in one at a time; i for two bars, then VI and VII; a
second part on a marimba and a slow theme on bells.

<a id="get_the_traps_egon"></a>
## Spooky Funk Film Theme: `get_the_traps_egon.yml`

A mid-eighties spooky funk-pop film theme in the manner of Ghostbusters (Ray Parker Jr.), with a
riff of its own. Every bar goes I for two beats, then bVII and IV for one each: synth brass hits and
a muted funk guitar on the chords, a synth bass riff, a line that a shout answers, a middle on IV
and V, and ghostly whistles over the drums.

<a id="not_star_trek"></a>
## Symphonic Space Theme: `not_star_trek.yml`

A majestic symphonic space-opera theme in the manner of the original Battlestar Galactica (Stu
Phillips), with a fanfare of its own. A trumpet fanfare in dotted rhythms and leaps over brass
chords, timpani and a marching snare, turning through the borrowed chords bVI and bVII back to I; a
lyrical second theme on the strings; a bridge on the horns.

<a id="strange_woodworking"></a>
## Analog-Synth Score: `strange_woodworking.yml`

A dark analog-synth score in the manner of Survive and John Carpenter, built on an arpeggiated
sequence. One chord arpeggiated in sixteenths runs through everything, barely changing; a pulsing
bass on one note, a slow pad, a heartbeat kick and a plain theme in long notes on i VI iv v.

<a id="tumbleweeds"></a>
## Italian Western Theme: `tumbleweeds.yml`

An Italian western film theme of the sixties in the manner of the theme of The Good, the Bad and the
Ugly (Ennio Morricone), with a tune of its own. Galloping tom-toms; an ocarina calls and men's
voices answer; a twanging guitar plays the theme on i and a major IV; a trumpet climbs over choir
and strings; a harmonica alone with a bell in the middle.

<a id="very_large_mammals"></a>
## Boogie-Woogie Film Tune: `very_large_mammals.yml`

A lumbering boogie-woogie film tune in the manner of Baby Elephant Walk (Henry Mancini), with a tune
of its own. A twelve-bar blues: a boogie bass doubled by a tuba, so that it lumbers, an organ on the
offbeats, a comic tune high on a calliope that leaves gaps, and brass answering in the gaps.
